from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single liability record extracted from one financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the filing")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label used in the document (e.g., 'Total Liabilities', 'Expense reserve')")
    amount_reported: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the liability as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    note_on_comparison: str | None = Field(description="Any text noting if this figure is non-standard or non-comparable to corporate liabilities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
